what: Sanitize runs after the only empty-name guard
scenario_or_breakage: An all-control-byte gh job name passes `[ -n "$raw_name" ]`, sanitizes to empty, still increments `count` and can emit a blank TSV/`emit` row; Edge cases §2 wrongly claims line 107 catches this
suggested_fix: Sanitize first then `[ -n "$raw_name" ] || continue`, or repeat the empty guard immediately after assignment
